howItWorksPage.title: How OgroniEdu Works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Bangladesh's verified education ecosystem connecting ambitious learners with screened university educators.
howItWorksPage.forStudentsSubheading: Safe, vetted, and backed by a 100% replacement guarantee
howItWorksPage.studentStep1Desc: Browse verified tutors by class (Primary to Admission), curriculum (Bangla/English Version, Edexcel/Cambridge), district, and subject.
howItWorksPage.studentStep2Desc: Send your learning requirements, preferred schedule, and tuition mode (in-person or online). No upfront commitment required.
howItWorksPage.studentStep3Desc: Pay tuition fees safely via bKash or SSLCOMMERZ held in escrow. Tutors are only paid after sessions are successfully completed.
howItWorksPage.studentStep4Desc: Conduct classes with digital attendance, shared study materials, homework tracking, and guardian session alerts.
howItWorksPage.studentStep5Desc: Not satisfied within the first 3 sessions? Request a tutor replacement or receive an administrative refund with zero hassle.
howItWorksPage.forTutorsSubheading: Monetize your academic expertise with dignity and guaranteed payouts
howItWorksPage.tutorStep1Desc: Create your profile and submit your National ID (NID) and university degree or student identity credentials.
howItWorksPage.tutorStep2Desc: Our Dhaka compliance team reviews documents within 24-48 hours. Upon approval, receive 'Verified Tutor' and 'NID Verified' trust badges.
howItWorksPage.tutorStep3Desc: Define your hourly tuition rates (BDT) and set your weekly availability with conflict-free calendar booking.
howItWorksPage.tutorStep4Desc: Receive tuition inquiries directly from verified parents and students. Accept requests matching your location and preferences.
howItWorksPage.tutorStep5Desc: Earn 92% of gross fees with automated bank or MFS settlements every week. No delayed fees or uncollected tuitions.

safetyPage.title: Child Safety, Minor Consent & Trust Standards
safetyPage.subtitle: OgroniEdu is engineered with multi-layered safety mechanisms to protect children, guardians, and educators across Bangladesh.
safetyPage.minorPolicyDesc: In accordance with Bangladeshi legal standards, students under 18 must be linked to a verified guardian profile. Guardians retain complete visibility over bookings, tutor profiles, class attendance, and tutor communication.
safetyPage.screeningDesc: Every tutor must pass mandatory National ID (NID) checks, address validation, and official academic document screening before receiving verified badge status or being allowed to accept tuition requests.
safetyPage.monitoredChatDesc: All communications remain strictly within the OgroniEdu platform. Our automated safety algorithms monitor and redact phone numbers, payment solicitation, and abusive language to prevent off-platform harassment.
safetyPage.emergencyEscalationDesc: Any safety report marked under 'Child Safety' or 'Harassment' triggers an immediate high-priority alert. Operations teams respond within 2 hours with immediate account suspension capabilities.
safetyPage.replacementGuaranteeDesc: If a tutor engages in unprofessional conduct, late arrivals, or incompatible teaching style, guardians can file an instant replacement case without financial loss.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find fast answers about finding tutors, making payments, safety policies, and our guarantee.
faqPage.a1: Every tutor must upload their National ID (NID) and verified university credentials (student ID, graduation certificate, or transcript). Our compliance reviewers manually verify these against university registries and national databases before approving profiles.
faqPage.q2: How does tuition fee payment work?
faqPage.a2: Tuition fees are paid digitally through bKash, Nagad, or credit/debit cards via SSLCOMMERZ. Fees are held in a secure escrow holding account and disbursed to the tutor only after scheduled sessions are completed.
faqPage.q3: What happens if I am not satisfied with the tutor?
faqPage.a3: Under our 100% Tutor Replacement Guarantee, if you are not satisfied within the first 3 sessions, you can submit a replacement request. We will match you with a vetted alternative tutor or issue an administrative refund.
faqPage.q4: Can a student under 18 hire a tutor directly?
faqPage.a4: No. Learners under 18 require a linked guardian account. Guardians have complete oversight of bookings, session schedules, and communication to ensure minor safety.
faqPage.q5: How does the 8% platform commission work for tutors?
faqPage.a5: Tutors set their own hourly rates. Upon completion of each verified session, 92% of the session fee is credited to the tutor's payable balance, and 8% is retained by OgroniEdu to cover verification, escrow, and platform maintenance.
faqPage.q6: Can classes be conducted online or in-person?
faqPage.a6: Both! Tutors specify whether they offer In-Person home tuition, Online classes via integrated digital rooms, or Hybrid tuition. You can filter tutors by your preferred mode.

legalTermsPage.title: Terms of Service
legalTermsPage.subtitle: Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • Governed by the Laws of Bangladesh
legalTermsPage.introText: Welcome to OgroniEdu. By accessing or using our tutoring matching platform, learning portal, and payment services, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service.
legalTermsPage.sec1Text: Users must be at least 18 years old to create an independent account. For learners under 18, an authorized parent or guardian must create and manage the account. Tutors must provide authentic National ID (NID) cards and university academic records.
legalTermsPage.sec2Text: Tutors registered on OgroniEdu are independent academic educators and not employees of OgroniEdu. While we perform strict NID and degree credential verification, users understand that tutoring outcomes are driven by mutual student-tutor engagement.
legalTermsPage.sec3Text: All payments must be processed digitally through the OgroniEdu platform. Payments are deposited into an audited escrow account and disbursed following session completion. An 8% platform service fee is applied to completed sessions.
legalTermsPage.sec4Text: Sessions may be rescheduled with at least 12 hours notice. Guardians unsatisfied within the first 3 sessions may invoke the 100% Tutor Replacement Guarantee to switch educators or request an administrative refund.
legalTermsPage.sec5Text: Harassment, inappropriate conduct, off-platform payment circumvention, or falsification of credentials will result in immediate termination of account access and referral to legal authorities where warranted.

privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.subtitle: Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • Compliance with Bangladesh Cyber & Data Privacy Standards
privacyPolicyPage.introText: OgroniEdu is committed to protecting the privacy, dignity, and confidential information of students, guardians, and educators. This Privacy Policy outlines how we gather, protect, and handle data.
privacyPolicyPage.sec1Text: We collect full names, verified phone numbers, email addresses, geographic areas in Bangladesh, academic qualifications, and National ID (NID) evidence strictly for identity validation and safety.
privacyPolicyPage.sec2Text: We do not market directly to minors. Learner accounts under 18 years of age are linked to parents or guardians who maintain complete control over data visibility and permissions.
privacyPolicyPage.sec3Text: All uploaded National IDs and credential documents are stored in private encrypted storage buckets with expiring signed URLs. Raw identity documents are never shared publicly or exposed to other users.
privacyPolicyPage.sec4Text: We never sell, rent, or lease user personal information or contact details to third-party telemarketers or advertisers under any circumstances.
privacyPolicyPage.sec5Text: Users possess the right to view, update, and request full deletion of their account records upon settling outstanding tuition or financial balances.
